{{Quote|Here's the best reward you'll find in Mos Taike: my sister's specialty! Don't show it around, or everyone will want a slice.|Bren Kingal, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BK" />}}
The '''sister''' of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Bren Kingal]] had a secret [[Kingal family|family]] recipe for a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dessert]] known as [[Eopie Cream Pie]]. Kingal considered [[Gender/Legends|his]] sister's [[Pie/Legends|pie]] the best reward in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], gifting one of them to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] whom he had [[Death/Legends|kill]] a local [[Trone Thanamiroc|murderer]].<ref name="SWG:BK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bren Kingal's sister was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG:BK" /> Prior to ''Galaxies''{{'}} closure in [[2011]],<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> if the player successfully completed a quest for Bren Kingal called "Mission 4: Trone Thanamiroc," Kingal would mention his sister while distributing an Eopie Cream Pie as a reward.<ref name="SWG:BK" />
